goal: Iske baad aap har shape ke liye sahi graphics.h function chun sakenge, colours sahi tarteeb mein set kar sakenge, band shape ko fill kar sakenge aur graphics screen par text likh sakenge.
warmup: Bazaar mein dukaan ke liye signboard banate painter ko sochein. Woh pehle brush ka rang chunta hai, phir outline banata hai, phir usay paint se bharta hai. Agar woh pehle paint kare aur rang baad mein chune, to sign galat ban jata hai. Graphics programs bhi aise hi kaam karte hain: pehle colour chunein, phir draw karein.
definition: graphics.h aap ko screen par draw karne ke liye tayyar functions deta hai: har qisam ki shape ke liye ek function (line, rectangle, circle, ellipse, arc), colours chunne ke functions, aur fill karne aur text likhne ke functions. Screen ko graphics mode mein badalne ke liye pehle initgraph call karte hain aur aakhir mein closegraph. graphics.h standard C++ nahi hai. Yeh sirf lab PC par Turbo C++ (DOSBox) ya Code::Blocks/Dev-C++ ke saath WinBGIm library mein chalta hai, is liye page ka in-page compiler in programs ko nahi chala sakta. Is page ka canvas ek simulation hai jo woh draw karta hai jo wohi calls draw karti.
howItWorks: Har program ka frame ek jaisa hota hai: shuru mein initgraph, beech mein drawing, key ka intezar karne ke liye getch, aur aakhir mein closegraph. Beech mein ek rule follow karein: colour usi shape se PEHLE SET karein jo use istemal kare, kyunke setcolor sirf apne baad bani shapes par asar karta hai. Colours naam wale constants hain jaise RED, GREEN, YELLOW aur WHITE (asal mein chhote numbers, magar naam hi use karein). Shape ke andar rang bharne ke liye setfillstyle(SOLID_FILL, colour) call karein aur phir floodfill(x, y, border) shape ke ANDAR ke point ke saath; teesra argument outline ka colour hona chahiye, aur outline BAND honi chahiye, warna rang bahar nikal kar poori screen bhar deta hai. ellipse aur arc ke angles degrees (0 se 360) mein hote hain.
